messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Match the shape and styling of the hair in the reference images, while retaining the current person's facial features, hair color, and clothing. Leave the rest of the video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Match the shape and styling of the hair in the reference images, while retaining the current person's facial features, hair color, and clothing. Leave the rest of the video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The figure stands mostly still, then briefly raises the right hand to the mouth and chin before lowering the arm and returning to a standing pose.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body shot keeps the figure centered from head to toe.","clothing":"A blue-gray military-style uniform with a double-breasted jacket, gold buttons, a gold belt buckle, shoulder insignia, and matching trousers, finished with black shoes.","hair_color":"Deep purple or magenta.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled back into a high ponytail with a few loose strands at the nape.","identity":"A 3D-rendered adult figure with a dark complexion, slim build, and a short face with a neutral expression.","scene":"An outdoor rooftop or plaza with light paving tiles, a low concrete wall, and a background of buildings, communication towers, and antennas under a clear blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's short cropped hair was replaced with a high ponytail, with the hair pulled back and a visible tail at the back. The purple hair color, uniform, facial features, scene, and animation largely remained consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's hairstyle to match the reference images, retaining facial features, hair color, and clothing while leaving the rest unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the ponytail shape and styling fully match the reference images, since the reference shows a more voluminous, textured ponytail and the output shows a simpler high ponytail.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly cropped or reframed compared with the source, with black bars visible on the sides in some frames.
